case_title.quote: MUKESH & ANR. v. STATE FOR NCT OF DELHI & ORS.
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

number_of_accused.quote: his friend ... was surrounded and attacked by at least six accused persons
number_of_accused.reason: Judgment repeatedly refers to a gang of six accused in the bus.

accused_gender.reason: All accused are described as male persons throughout the judgment.

accused_age.reason: No age of the adult accused is given; only a juvenile and FIR description of 25-30 years appear.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Bus driver (A-1 Ram Singh) and bus helper/cleaner (A-3 Akshay)
accused_occupation.quote: A-1, Ram Singh, ... was the driver of the bus and A-3, Akshay, was working as a helper in the bus
accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states occupations of the bus driver and helper, contrary to 'Not stated'.

accused_socioeconomic_status.correct_value: Accused claim ordinary/poor background, not much educated
accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: they hail from an ordinary/ poor background and are not much educated
accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Judgment records the accused's claimed poor background in their affidavits.

previous_criminal_record.correct_value: Accused stated they have no criminal antecedents (their claim in affidavits; not verified in judgment)
previous_criminal_record.quote: Accused also stated that they have no criminal antecedents
previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment records the accused's statement about absence of criminal antecedents.

victim_age.quote: the twenty-three year old lady, a para-medical student
victim_age.reason: Judgment states the victim was twenty-three.

victim_caste.reason: Victim caste is not stated in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Victim religion is not stated in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment does not describe the accused as strangers; it only says they boarded and attacked the victims.

offence_category.quote: Forcible sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix, one after the other by six persons
offence_category.reason: Primary offence is gang rape of the prosecutrix.

statutory_provisions.reason: Section 34 is not in the case charges; many other charged sections such as 307, 365/366, 397, 201 and 412 are omitted.

weapon.quote: insertion of iron rod in her private parts
weapon.reason: Iron rods were the weapon used and recovered, as the judgment states.

evidence_type.quote: The chain of events described by the prosecutrix in her dying declarations coupled with the testimonies of the other witnesses
evidence_type.reason: Judgment relies on dying declarations, eyewitness testimony, medical, DNA, odontology and recovery evidence.

confession.quote: Mr. Luthra, learned senior counsel for the State, has not placed reliance on any kind of confessional statement made by the accused persons.
confession.reason: Prosecution relied on disclosure-based recoveries and not confessions.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: The brutal, barbaric and diabolic nature of the crime
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Listed aggravating factors match the judgment's reasoning.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: the aged parents, marital status and the young children
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Mitigating factors listed match those the appellants raised and the court considered.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted all the accused persons ... sentenced to death for offence punishable under Section 302
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted and imposed death sentence under s.302.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court affirmed conviction and confirmed the death penalty on 13.03.2014
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court, vide judgment dated 13.03.2014, affirmed the conviction and confirmed the death penalty
high_court_outcome.reason: Judgment states the High Court affirmed conviction and confirmed death sentence, not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed appeals; convictions and death sentence stand.

offence_finally_established.quote: the prosecution has proved the charges leveled against the appellants beyond reasonable doubt
offence_finally_established.reason: Rape, conspiracy and murder findings are affirmed.

imprisonment_type.reason: Death sentence was confirmed for the appellants.

imprisonment_years.reason: No term of years applies to the death sentence.

fine_rs.reason: Death sentence case; no fine amount is stated for the death-sentence convicts.

neutral_facts.correct_value: A neutral summary of the incident without stating the court's conviction outcome or the court's finding of agreement
neutral_facts.quote: The accused were found guilty of rape, criminal conspiracy, and murder.
neutral_facts.reason: Neutral facts reveal the court outcome and state court findings as facts, which is prohibited.

offence_severity.correct_value: Gang rape with iron rod insertion and death; death penalty upheld as rarest of rare case
offence_severity.quote: The instant case clearly comes within the category of 'rarest of rare case'
offence_severity.reason: Captures sentencing issue but does not describe offence severity itself; mixes sentencing with severity.

attempt_completion.quote: the life-spark that moves the bodily frame got extinguished
attempt_completion.reason: Offences were completed and the victim died.

physical_harm.quote: insertion of rod in her private parts that, inter alia, caused perforation of her intestine which caused sepsis and, ultimately, led to her death
physical_harm.reason: Matches the judgment's description of physical harm.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Four appellants' convictions upheld; accused Ram Singh's proceedings abated on his death; juvenile not before this court
number_of_offences.quote: the proceedings qua him stood abated
number_of_offences.reason: Six persons were involved, but only four appellants were upheld; Ram Singh's case abated.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Robbery of mobiles, debit and credit cards, cash, rings, watch and shoes from victims
financial_property_loss.quote: The accused persons robbed her of her belongings
financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment records robbery of the victims' property, so 'Not applicable' is wrong.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Court found prior concert/agreement formed as soon as victims boarded the bus; not premeditation as such
premeditation_planning.quote: as soon as the informant and the prosecutrix boarded the bus, the accused persons formed an agreement
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found prior agreement/conspiracy, but did not expressly find premeditation or planning.

motive.quote: the gross sadistic and beastly instinctual pleasures came to the forefront
motive.reason: Judgment attributes motive to lust and sadistic gratification.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The chain of events described by the prosecutrix in her dying declarations coupled with the testimonies of the other witnesses
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the judgment's key evidence reasoning on conspiracy.

witness_credibility.quote: The evidence of PW-1 is unimpeachable in character and the roving cross-examination has not eroded his credibility
witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the court's finding on PW-1's credibility.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Attempted to run the bus over victims, washed the bus, burnt clothes, destroyed evidence, divided loot
post_offence_conduct.quote: They made all possible efforts in destroying the evidence
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment records post-offence conduct including destruction of evidence and dividing loot.

custody_duration.correct_value: Accused in custody for almost four years at time of sentencing hearing
custody_duration.quote: since they are in custody for almost four years
custody_duration.reason: Judgment states the accused had been in custody for almost four years.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not discussed in the judgment.

trial_duration.reason: Trial duration is not stated in the judgment.

legal_representation.correct_value: Sidharth Luthra (Sr. Adv.) for the State; M.L. Sharma and A.P. Singh for appellants; Raju Ramachandran and Sanjay Hegde as amici
legal_representation.quote: Mr. Siddharth Luthra, learned senior counsel for the respondent-State
legal_representation.reason: Judgment names counsel for the State, appellants and amici curiae.

investigation_status.quote: the chargesheet came to be filed on 03.01.2013
investigation_status.reason: Investigation completed with charge sheet filed and trial conducted.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Alleged non-compliance with s.235(2) CrPC on sentence hearing, remedied by Court giving opportunity; other alleged irregularities in FIR, recoveries and dying declarations argued
procedural_irregularity.quote: In the present case, the latter course is adopted.
procedural_irregularity.reason: Judgment discusses procedural irregularity claims and a remedial sentencing hearing, not 'None noted'.

appeal_history.quote: affirmed the conviction and confirmed the death penalty
appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court affirmation and Supreme Court dismissal are accurately described.

prosecution_argument.quote: the accused persons formed an agreement to commit heinous offences against the victim
prosecution_argument.reason: Summary of the prosecution's conspiracy and joint-liability case is supported.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence challenged FIR delay, omissions in PW-1's statements, iron rod use, DNA and recoveries, plus alibi; on sentence argued mitigating background, youth and custody conduct
defence_argument.quote: the aged parents, marital status and the young children
defence_argument.reason: Covers sentencing mitigation but omits the main challenges to evidence, FIR delay and alibi.

legal_principle_applied.quote: Section 376(2)(g) read with Explanation I thus embodies a principle of joint liability
legal_principle_applied.reason: Joint liability principle under s.376(2)(g) with Explanation I is correctly stated.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Machhi Singh v. State of Punjab
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Listed precedents are cited by the court, though the list is not exhaustive.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the instant case clearly comes within the category of 'rarest of rare case' where the question of any other punishment is 'unquestionably foreclosed'
sentencing_rationale.reason: Accurately states the rarest of rare rationale for death sentence.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: Accused also stated that they have no criminal antecedents
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court considered the mitigating factors, though found them insufficient.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: the aggravating circumstances outweigh the mitigating circumstances now brought on record
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Accurately reflects the court's weighing of aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.reason: No other sentence order such as remission or term imposed is stated beyond death sentence affirmation.
